thread:
maria: incidents-bot just paged for EU region, high GPU pool queue growth in eu-west1. seeing autoscaler requests failing to get capacity.
incidents-bot: Pager: region=eu-west1 pool=serve-gpu-01 reason=GPU_QUOTA_LIMIT_EXCEEDED severity=sev2
jeff: oncall here, joining. what's current queue depth?
sam: pending inference requests ~18k across shard 3, Pending pods stuck in ContainerCreating, kube events show quota denied on node creation
kai: GCP API errors in the logs: "quotaExceeded: quota exceeded for project \"redwood-prod\" on compute.instances.create" — autoscaler retries are hitting the project limit
maria: customer impact: a subset of EU customers report 5-10s additional latency and some 503s for long generations. not full outage but degraded.
jeff: immediate steps: 1) short-circuit non-EU traffic to us-west1 for non-PHI workloads 2) enable model fallback to smaller quantized variant for low-priority queue 3) reduce max-batch size on the pending queues
sam: deploying edge rule now to prefer us-west1 for routes without data residency tags (deploy edge/route-reroute-eu->us-west1)
incidents-bot: Runbook step executed: reroute-rule applied (link: https://console.redwood/edges/rules/1982)
kai: opened GCP quota case: case#CASE-2026-789 (link to cloud console), also put in an emergency quota increase request for GPUs in europe-west1
maria: can we also spin up a temporary CPU fallback pool for queued low-priority jobs to reduce burst? that should free up GPU headroom for high-priority traffic
sam: starting a cpu-fallback job queue and toggling prioritizer: 
```
# enable cpu fallback for low-priority queue
kubectl apply -f k8s/fallback-cpu-pool.yaml
redwoodctl route update --queue low-priority --fallback cpu-pool-eu
```
jeff: good. notify support & sales about possible customer-facing communications. @support-team please prepare a short note.
support-team: drafting now, will include affected regions, mitigation steps, and ETA for permanent fix :pencil2:
kai: autoscaler logs attached: 
```
E0307 12:03:44 autoscaler.go:212] request failed: compute.instances.create: quotaExceeded
E0307 12:03:49 autoscaler.go:215] retrying, attempt 3
E0307 12:04:12 autoscaler.go:230] final: denied - no more quota
```
maria: handing over to capacity oncall for quota follow-up and long term mitigation. tagging @alex to take lead on quota escalations.
alex: I got it, taking over. I'll follow up with GCP rep and coordinate any project-level quota moves or project splits. ETA 30m to get support response.
sam: metrics: token-per-second dropped 27%, tail latency spiked to 2.4s p95 for EU region, queued jobs backpressure triggered throttling in ingress.
jeff: temporary traffic shaping applied: rejecting low-priority requests >90s, dropping oversized batches, throttling test traffic.
incidents-bot: note: runbook record created: https://incidents.redwood/1766004321
maria: postmortem checklist items: - root cause: exhausted GCP GPU quota in eu-west1 blocked autoscaler create calls - impact: degraded latency and some 503s for long inference jobs - mitigations: cross-region reroute, cpu fallback, batch-size reduction, quota request case opened - follow-ups: add proactive quota monitoring/alerts, increase headroom, consider multi-project allocation for GPUs
alex: will own follow-ups on quota and coordinate with finance/infra for committed capacity or Dedicated allocation in EU if needed.
sam: thanks everyone. I'll keep the cpu-fallback and reroute active until we get quota confirmation. marking this thread as in-progress and will update as alex reports back.
maria: closing the immediate page; keep this thread for updates. :white_check_mark:
